queries:
WITH r AS (
  SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS a FROM film WHERE length IS NOT NULL GROUP BY rating
),
b AS (SELECT AVG(length) AS base FROM film WHERE length IS NOT NULL),
s1 AS (
  SELECT AVG(a) AS m FROM r, b WHERE r.a > b.base
),
f AS (
  SELECT r.a FROM r, b, s1 WHERE r.a > b.base AND r.a > s1.m
)
SELECT AVG(f.a), AVG(f.a - b.base), AVG(f.a - s1.m)
FROM f, b, s1;
WITH rating_avg AS (
  SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS avg_len
  FROM film
  GROUP BY rating
),
stage1 AS (
  SELECT rating, avg_len
  FROM rating_avg
  WHERE avg_len >= (SELECT AVG(length) FROM film)
)
SELECT rating
FROM stage1
WHERE avg_len >= (SELECT AVG(avg_len) FROM stage1);
SELECT rating
FROM film
GROUP BY rating
HAVING AVG(length) > (SELECT AVG(avg_len) FROM (SELECT AVG(length) AS avg_len FROM film GROUP BY rating));
